ActorResistanceLevel.description: Content-declared resistance tier; `normal` is expressed by omission.

baseShotDeltaPercent.description: Additive RFB `base_shot` value in hundredths of a shot. `15` means +0.15 shots.

launcherMultiplierDeltaPercent.description: Additive launcher damage multiplier in percentage points. `25` means +x0.25.

lifePercent.description: Additive adjustment to RFB's equipment life multiplier. `9` means +9% max HP.

savingThrowSkillOverride.description: Replaces the final saving-throw skill while a status grants this bundle.

effectProgramId.description:
Source-only effect-program reference. Pack compilation resolves and
clears this field before encoding compiled content.

durationTurns.description:
Item summons are permanent in v117; this field is fixed at zero
so the shared resolver cannot create an invalid ability identity.

RfbEgoGenerationDefinition.description:
Identity and allocation inputs copied from one authoritative `e_info`
record. Affixes without this metadata never enter the RFB ego pool.

RfbEgoTypeDefinition.description: Authoritative `T:` category used by RFB's ego allocation table.

brands.description:
Elemental brands multiplying melee weapon dice unless the target is
immune to the matching element.

deviceGeneration.description:
Optional activation contributed by this affix. The generated activation
and charges are materialized on the item instance like an intrinsic
device activation.

elementalDestructionImmunities.description: RFB `OF_IGNORE_*` protections contributed by this affix.

elementalDestructionVulnerabilities.description: RFB object elements that can destroy an item carrying this affix.

equipmentBonuses.description: Equipment-only combat, skill, and sensory bonuses.

generationLevel.description: Original generation level used by Mogaminator's level predicate.

generationMaxLevel.description: Original maximum generation depth. `u16::MAX` means unrestricted.

namePlacement.description: Whether this affix composes around or replaces the base item name.

passives.description: Passive capabilities granted while the affixed item is equipped.

preservesOrdinaryQuality.description: Keeps a fixed reward affix without promoting the item above ordinary quality.

protectsQuiverAmmunition.description: Protects ammunition assigned to this equipped quiver from inventory damage.

resistances.description:
Defensive resistance tiers granted while the affixed item is
equipped.

resistsMonsterDestruction.description: Protects instances from `KILL_ITEM`; used by Endurance ammunition.

resistsProjectionDestruction.description: Protects instances carrying this affix from projection-driven item destruction.

rfbEgo.description: Optional authoritative RFB ego identity and allocation metadata.

rollGroups.description:
Generation-time weighted rolls. Results are materialized into the
item instance and never recomputed while loading a save.

slays.description:
Target categories receiving an original-compatible slay or kill
multiplier from melee weapon dice.

statusImmunities.description:
Status kind ids the wearer is immune to while the affixed item is
equipped.
